$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}y}=-4{y}^{3}\,⟹\,(-\frac{1}{4})\text{d}u={y}^{3}\,\text{d}y,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{4{y}^{3}}{{(12-{y}^{4})}^{5}}\,\text{d}y & =4\int \frac{1}{{(12-{y}^{4})}^{5}}\cdot {y}^{3}\,\text{d}y \\  & =4\int \frac{1}{{u}^{5}}\cdot (-\frac{1}{4})\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{4}{4}\int \frac{1}{{u}^{5}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\int \frac{1}{{u}^{5}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-(-\frac{1}{4{u}^{4}})+C \\  & =\frac{1}{4{u}^{4}}+C \\  & =\frac{1}{4{(12-{y}^{4})}^{4}}+C\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["8d111a2e-9476-57d5-8ade-195346a8bc68"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "e3862629-13a1-5e69-89a7-08fb717479fc" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186068786.py"} [:db/add 17592186068786 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] {:db/id 17592186068786 :knowledge-point/questions ["99e025e4-1ea6-5d6e-812a-92d3fa45174a"]} [:db/ensure 17592186068786 :knowledge-point/validate]]
